ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran collective systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalise distributed nanite identity, local peer coordination and powered relay architecture. Linked Asuran minds can reinforce one another's reconstruction, while dedicated archives can extend the collective across an entire map.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran pattern continuity
ResearchProjectDef.description: Store periodically refreshed identity, skill, trait and age states inside a powered pattern archive, then rebuild a destroyed human-form nanite body from the most recent viable state. Older backups impose greater memory loss and cannot restore events or relationships that were never archived.
